column1: Notes on reading the source workbook

Its "New %" column is each ad set's SHARE of its region's new budget (it sums to 100% per region), NOT a growth rate. TAL-B2BEACON in ANZ shows 25% share but was topped up only +5.3%. Uplift = Change / Current and is not in the file.

The top-up is a per-region allocation applied consistently to BOTH channels - ASEAN is +55.9% on LinkedIn and TTD alike, India +47.4% on both - so the regional percentages, not the per-line ones, are the decision that was made.

Within almost every region the money went to the whitelist/3PA awareness lines while the Bombora TAL lines got the least (+5.1% to +21.5%). The workbook's own note offers to reweight to protect the TAL accounts; nobody has answered that.
